overview:
Discover the royal charm of Rajasthan with the Grand Rajasthan Heritage Tour Package by Safar Trails, a memorable 7-day journey through Jaipur, Jodhpur, Jaisalmer and Udaipur. Explore magnificent forts, historic palaces, colourful markets, traditional Rajasthani culture and the golden sand dunes of the Thar Desert.

Whether you are planning a family holiday, a cultural getaway or a memorable trip with friends, this Rajasthan tour package combines heritage sightseeing, desert experiences and comfortable stays in one thoughtfully planned itinerary.

The Grand Rajasthan Heritage Tour Package offers an opportunity to experience Rajasthan's fascinating history, architecture and local traditions across four iconic destinations. Begin your journey in Jaipur, the Pink City, known for its royal palaces, historic observatories and vibrant bazaars. Continue to Jodhpur, the Blue City, where the impressive Mehrangarh Fort overlooks the old town. In Jaisalmer, discover golden sandstone architecture and enjoy an unforgettable evening at Sam Sand Dunes. Conclude your holiday in Udaipur, the City of Lakes, famous for its palaces, temples and scenic lake views.

Safar Trails helps make your journey convenient with planned sightseeing, transfers, hotel or resort accommodation and meals as selected in your package. This 7-day Rajasthan holiday package is ideal for travellers looking to discover the state's architectural heritage, desert landscapes, cultural experiences and traditional hospitality in a single trip.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Jaipur – The Pink City
topPlacesToVisit.description: Explore Rajasthan's royal capital, known for its historic palaces, traditional markets and distinctive architecture. Places to visit: Amber Fort, City Palace, Hawa Mahal, Jantar Mantar, Jal Mahal, Albert Hall Museum and Birla Mandir.

topPlacesToVisit.description: Discover the historic charm of Jodhpur, with its imposing fort, blue-painted houses and lively old-city streets. Places to visit: Mehrangarh Fort, Jaswant Thada and the Clock Tower market area.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Jaisalmer – The Golden City
topPlacesToVisit.description: Experience the sandstone architecture and desert atmosphere that make Jaisalmer one of Rajasthan's most distinctive destinations. Places to visit: Jaisalmer Fort, Patwon Ki Haveli, Salim Singh Ki Haveli, Gadisar Lake and Sam Sand Dunes.
